name: Homestuck: Beyond Canon
source:
Homestuck: Beyond Canon is the official successor to critically acclaimed visual novel [url=/v31659]Homestuck[/url]. It continues directly from the end of both routes of its sequel webnovel, [url=https://www.homestuck.com/epilogues]The Homestuck Epilogues[/url].

The initial demo release ("Homestuck^2") went on hiatus on December 25, 2020. The full version picked up where it left off on October 8, 2023, with an entirely new staff.
translation:
《Homestuck: Beyond Canon》是广受好评的视觉小说[url=/v31659]《Homestuck》[/url]的官方续作。剧情直接承接其续篇网络小说[url=https://www.homestuck.com/epilogues]《The Homestuck Epilogues》[/url]两条路线的结局。

最初推出的试玩版本“Homestuck^2”，于2020年12月25日停止更新。2023年10月8日，全新团队接手续写，完整版从先前中断的地方继续展开。
